title: Inventory: locations, transfers, stock levels, replenishment
summary: One warehouse with one-step receipts and deliveries; transfers with stock moves; check availability and reserve; validate with or without backorder; stock levels and counts; min/max reorder rules generating RFQs.
design: Odoo-inspired, Mendix-native (intake Q3): Odoo is the functional reference; simplifications listed and signed off at the Stage 2 gate

useCases.title: Process a receipt
preconditions: Receipt Ready (from a PO, F007, or manual)
postconditions: Stock increased; PO received quantities updated
mainFlow: 1. User opens Inventory > Receipts and a Ready receipt
2. Enters received quantities per move (default = demand)
3. Clicks Validate
4. If less than demand: system asks Create backorder? (UC004)
5. System moves stock Vendors -> WH/Stock, status Done, date done

useCases.title: Process a delivery
postconditions: Stock decreased; SO delivered quantities updated
mainFlow: 1. User opens a delivery; clicks Check availability
2. System reserves on-hand stock (Ready if fully reserved, else stays Waiting)
3. User sets picked quantities and validates (backorder per UC004)
4. System moves stock WH/Stock -> Customers

useCases.title: Create a manual transfer
mainFlow: 1. User creates a transfer: operation type, partner, locations, products and quantities
2. Clicks Mark as todo (confirm) and continues as UC001/UC002

useCases.title: Validate with less than the demand (backorder)
postconditions: Done transfer for the processed quantity; new Waiting/Ready backorder for the rest, or rest cancelled
mainFlow: 1. System shows the backorder dialog
2. User chooses Create backorder or No backorder
3. System splits moves: done part + remaining part into a new transfer linked via Transfer_Backorder, or cancels the remainder

useCases.title: Cancel a transfer
mainFlow: 1. User clicks Cancel
2. System unreserves and cancels the moves

useCases.title: Check stock and count inventory
postconditions: Stock levels corrected with an adjustment move
mainFlow: 1. User opens Stock (per product/location) from the StockOnHand view
2. Enters counted quantities
3. Clicks Apply: system creates a done move from/to Inventory adjustment for the difference and clears the count

useCases.title: Replenish with reorder rules
postconditions: RFQ created or increased for the vendor
mainFlow: 1. Scheduled event (daily) or user clicks Order once / Run scheduler
2. For each rule: forecast = on hand + incoming - outgoing
3. If forecast < min: quantity = max - forecast rounded up to the multiple
4. System adds a line to an open RFQ for the vendor or creates a new RFQ (source = rule name)

useCases.title: Configure the warehouse
postconditions: Warehouse name, address, stock location and operation types (numbering, default locations, backorder policy) set
mainFlow: 1. Manager opens Configuration > Warehouse
2. Edits name, short name and address
3. Edits the operation types: name, sequence code, default source/destination location, create backorder

domainEntities.name: Inventory.Warehouse
domainEntities.purpose: The (single) warehouse: its stock location and operation types.

odooConstraints.message: The name of the warehouse must be unique per company!
The short name of the warehouse must be unique per company!

domainEntities.note: reception_steps / delivery_steps fixed to one step; no routes/rules.

domainEntities.name: Inventory.Location
domainEntities.purpose: A physical or virtual place stock moves from/to (WH/Stock, Vendors, Customers, Inventory adjustment).

odooConstraints.message: The barcode for a location must be unique per company!
odooConstraints.disposition: not-applicable: barcodes are not maintained (no scanning); locations share an empty barcode

odooConstraints.message: The inventory frequency (days) for a location must be non-negative
odooConstraints.disposition: not-applicable: Odoo field cyclic_inventory_frequency not carried

messages: Another parent/sub replenish location %s exists, if you wish to change it, uncheck it first
odooChecks.disposition: not-applicable: one stock location per warehouse, no replenish hierarchy

messages: You cannot set a location as a scrap location when it is assigned as a destination location for a manufacturing type operation.

domainEntities.name: Inventory.OperationType
domainEntities.purpose: Receipts, Delivery orders, Internal transfers: numbering and default locations.

messages: You cannot set a scrap location as the destination location for a manufacturing type operation.
odooChecks.disposition: not-applicable: scrap and manufacturing are out of scope

domainEntities.name: Inventory.Transfer
domainEntities.purpose: A receipt, delivery or internal transfer grouping stock moves.

odooConstraints.message: Reference must be unique per company!

associations.name: Transfer_Backorder
associations.note: the transfer this one is the backorder of

associations.name: Transfer_PurchaseOrder
associations.note: purchase_stock (computed in Odoo via moves; stored here)

domainEntities.name: Inventory.StockMove
domainEntities.purpose: Movement of one product quantity between two locations (stock.move.line merged in).

odooChecks.disposition: covered: Inventory.SUB_Transfer_AddMove takes the product unit

domainEntities.name: Inventory.StockLevel
domainEntities.purpose: Quantity of a product in an internal location (on hand, reserved, counted).

messages: Quants cannot be created for consumables or services.
odooChecks.disposition: covered: Inventory.SUB_StockLevel_Adjust keeps stock for tracked products only

messages: You cannot take products from or deliver products to a location of type "view" (%s).
odooChecks.disposition: covered: Inventory.SUB_StockLevel_Adjust keeps stock at internal locations only

messages: The Lot/Serial number (%s) is linked to another product.

domainEntities.note: No lots, packages or owners: one row per product × location.

domainEntities.name: Inventory.ReorderRule
domainEntities.purpose: Min/max replenishment rule: below minimum, create an RFQ up to maximum.

odooConstraints.message: Qty Multiple must be greater than or equal to zero.
A replenishment rule already exists for this product on this location.

messages: You have to select a product unit of measure that is in the same category as the default unit of measure of the product
odooChecks.disposition: not-applicable: reorder rules carry no unit

messages: The minimum quantity must be less than or equal to the maximum quantity.
odooChecks.disposition: val: Inventory.VAL_ReorderRule (minimum not above maximum; row save on the list)

associations.name: ReorderRule_PurchaseOrders
associations.note: new: RFQs this rule created; owned by Inventory so Purchasing never depends on Inventory

domainEntities.name: Inventory.ValidateTransferRequest
domainEntities.purpose: Wizard data: validate a transfer with less than the demand — create a backorder or not.

enumerations.name: Inventory.ENUM_TransferStatus
enumerations.note: 'waiting' (waiting another operation) dropped: no chained multi-step routes. Also used for stock moves

viewEntities.name: Inventory.StockOnHand
viewEntities.purpose: Per product: on hand, reserved, incoming and outgoing quantities (forecast).

microflows.name: ACT_Transfer_CheckAvailability
microflows.purpose: Reserve stock for outgoing moves from internal locations; incoming moves are always Ready.
hiddenRules: Reserve from StockLevel of the source location; transfer Ready only when all moves reserved (move_type direct=partial allowed in Odoo; here: Ready when anything reserved, shown per move)

microflows.name: ACT_Transfer_Validate
microflows.purpose: Validate: if any move short -> open backorder popup; else complete.
validations: At least one move with quantity > 0

microflows.name: SUB_Transfer_Done
microflows.purpose: Apply moves to StockLevel (source -, destination +), set Done and date; optional backorder; update order quantities.
hiddenRules: Stock only tracked for internal locations (Vendor/Customer/InventoryLoss are virtual)

microflows.name: ACT_StockLevel_ApplyCount
microflows.purpose: Create adjustment moves for counted quantities and clear the count.

microflows.name: SCE_ReorderRules_Run
microflows.purpose: Scheduled: evaluate automatic rules and create/extend RFQs.

microflows.name: SUB_ReorderRule_Replenish
microflows.purpose: One rule: compute qty to order and add it to an RFQ for the vendor.

pages.name: Transfer_NewEdit

pages.name: StockLevel_Overview
pages.purpose: Stock per product/location with editable counted quantity.

pages.name: ReorderRule_Overview
pages.purpose: Editable reorder rules with forecast and qty to order.

pages.name: Warehouse_Edit
pages.purpose: Warehouse, locations and operation types configuration.

timers.purpose: Scheduled: evaluate automatic rules and create/extend RFQs.

simplifications: One warehouse, one-step receipt and delivery; routes, rules, procurement groups and multi-step flows dropped.
stock.move.line merged into StockMove: no lots/serials, packages, owners or putaway.
Reservation simplified to on-hand minus reserved per location; no removal strategy.
Stock valuation (stock_account) deferred — no accounting entries on moves.
Returns (stock.return.picking) and scrap not in the first version.

putaway rules — single stock location
routes — fixed one-step receipt and delivery
stock rules — replaced by explicit microflows (confirm order -> transfer)
procurement grouping — transfers link directly to the sales/purchase order
